# Sweep fixture: naca2412_sweep_c60_s60_le20.stl

## Description
A swept NACA 2412 wing: constant 60 mm chord, but the whole 2D section translates in +X (aft / trailing-edge direction, i.e. swept back) as Z increases -- 20 mm of leading-edge sweep over 60 mm of span, linearly. Built from exactly 2 stations (root, tip): the X offset is affine in Z, so linear interpolation between the two translated outlines is geometrically exact at every intermediate Z.

## Origin convention
Same convention as the taper fixture: the unit section is scaled and translated per station, then every station is shifted by the same constant offset so the *root* station's own bounding box is centred on X=0, Y=0. The tip station's leading edge is therefore at local X=20.000000 mm relative to the root leading edge (i.e. the sweep offset, read back from the built geometry, not recomputed). Z is spanwise, root at Z=0, tip at Z=60 mm.

## Exact dimensions
- NACA designation: 2412 (m=0.02, p=0.4, t=0.12)
- Chord: 60 mm (constant)
- Span: 60 mm
- Leading-edge sweep: 20 mm total, linear with Z
- Leading-edge local X at root: -29.998250 mm
- Leading-edge local X at tip: -9.998250 mm (delta 20.000000 mm)
- SHA-256 (STL): 156dd92513bac88d814d6373558a690db6f902ada1090cb34f68bdbf3c62b33d
- Points per surface: 120 (cosine-spaced; outline vertex count 238)
- Stations: 2 (root, tip) -- geometrically exact for a linear sweep, see above
- Triangles: 948 (476 side wall + 472 cap)
- Format: binary STL, deterministic fixed ASCII header, no timestamps

## Local thickness by spanwise station
Chord is constant, so local max thickness is constant too -- included for parity with the other M5 fixtures and to confirm sweep alone does not change section thickness.

| Z (mm) | Chord (mm) | Local max thickness (mm) |

| 0 | 60.0000 | 7.1986 |
| 15 | 60.0000 | 7.1986 |
| 30 | 60.0000 | 7.1986 |
| 45 | 60.0000 | 7.1986 |
| 60 | 60.0000 | 7.1986 |

## Purpose
M5 fixture: the cross-section translates with Z. Exercises whether the structural pattern frame and world/object coordinate handling track a moving section origin correctly, independent of any chord or thickness change.

Generated by `python tools/make_fixtures.py sweep --naca 2412 --chord 60 --span 60 --sweep 20 --points 120`.
